definitions.explanation: The highest rank in professional sumo wrestling. A yokozuna is expected not only to be the strongest wrestler but also to embody dignity and grace.
Used figuratively to describe something or someone that is the undisputed best in their field.

examples.japanese: {新|しん}{横綱|よこづな}が{誕生|たんじょう}した。
{横綱|よこづな}は{土俵入|どひょうい}りで{注連縄|しめなわ}を{腰|こし}に{巻|ま}く。
examples.english: The yokozuna wears a sacred rope around the waist during the ring-entering ceremony.

examples.japanese: {連勝|れんしょう}が{途絶|とだ}え、{横綱|よこづな}としての{責任|せきにん}を{問|と}う{声|こえ}が{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: When the winning streak ended, voices arose questioning his responsibility as yokozuna.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}はラーメン{界|かい}の{横綱|よこづな}だ。
examples.english: This shop is the grand champion of the ramen world.

examples.japanese: {売上|うりあげ}では{業界|ぎょうかい}の{横綱|よこづな}と{言|い}われている。
examples.english: In terms of sales, they are called the champion of the industry.

examples.japanese: この{温泉|おんせん}は{全国|ぜんこく}の{温泉地|おんせんち}の{中|なか}でも{横綱|よこづな}{級|きゅう}だ。
examples.english: This hot spring is in the grand-champion class among hot spring resorts nationwide.

notes:
The word {横綱|よこづな} literally means "horizontal rope," referring to the thick sacred rope ({注連縄|しめなわ}) worn by the champion during ceremonies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {横綱|よこづな}に{昇進|しょうしん}する (to be promoted to yokozuna)
- {横綱|よこづな}{相撲|ずもう} (a dominant, champion-worthy performance)
- {横綱|よこづな}の{品格|ひんかく} (the dignity of a yokozuna)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Unlike other sumo ranks, a {横綱|よこづな} cannot be demoted — if performance declines, the only option is retirement ({引退|いんたい}). Promotion to {横綱|よこづな} requires not just winning records but also demonstrating {品格|ひんかく} (dignity) and {力量|りきりょう} (ability).
